description: This file is the main application entry point for a LightningJS frontend application, defining the root component, routes, and UI structure.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: The root application component created using Blits.Application, configuring components, state, template, routes, and computed properties.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the application's state with a debug flag.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Defines the UI structure with nested elements, error boundary, and dev overlay.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Sets up routing with a single route '/' mapped to the Home component.

methods.name: computed
methods.description: Provides computed properties for background color, debug overlay opacity, and route rendering.
